# Platform Next

> Platform Next is an all-in-one network acceleration and privacy management platform (VPN / proxy service). Users manage subscription links, configure multi-platform proxy clients and connect to global low-latency server nodes. Supported protocols include Sing-box, Xray, V2Ray, Hysteria, TUIC, Reality, Trojan and SSH; supported devices are iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.

The web dashboard at https://platformnext.dev is a static single-page app (Vietnamese by default, also English and Chinese). Account pages require signing in; public pages describe the service and link to the native apps.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://platformnext.dev/): product overview, features, FAQ, sign in / sign up
- [Download](https://platformnext.dev/download/): native apps for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux (latest versions from the release manifest)
- [Applications](https://platformnext.dev/applications/): third-party client apps that can import a Platform Next subscription (Sing-box, Clash, Shadowrocket, Quantumult X, V2rayN…)

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://docs.platformnext.dev): setup guides, subscription import, client configuration, troubleshooting
